needs.what: Station symbols (721) on a keyword (6+ Flying), plus the Spacecraft rule that the permanent is an artifact creature with its printed P/T (4/3) only at its highest station threshold (6+) and a noncreature artifact below it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities; a static `condition` on charge counters would leave the ability on the permanent, which the packet notes forbid for striations; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming an artifact creature at 6+ -- a counters-conditioned animate/set_types static would approximate rule 721 rather than implement station (same gap as inspirit_flagship_vessel and exploration_broodship)

needs.what: a 4/3 colorless Spacecraft Illusion artifact creature token with flying
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Spacecraft token at all; the Illusion tokens there are blue creature-only 1/1, 0/0 or 2/2 tokens, none a colorless 4/3 artifact creature with flying
